limitations: pnpm audit requires registry access; offline the gate fails closed instead of reporting a false green.
The working tree also contains pre-existing uncommitted notification, vitest and control-loop changes; they were preserved and re-verified, not authored by this mission.
Docker is not installed in this environment, so the container image was not built or run.
Release workflow triggers on main while the checkout branch is master; no remote is configured, so the default branch could not be confirmed. Release automation remains human-gated and unverified.
C02 (no rate limiting on MCP tools) was open when G-016 was measured; it was closed later with a per-tool token bucket, see docs/analysis/c02-mcp-rate-limit.json.
